name: VERITAS Collaboration

summary.plain: The scientists who built and run the VERITAS gamma-ray telescope array in Arizona.
summary.technical: Collaboration operating the VERITAS imaging-atmospheric-Cherenkov-telescope array; formed in 2000. Supported by the U.S. National Science Foundation and the Smithsonian Institution, NSERC in Canada, and the Helmholtz Association in Germany per the collaboration's own site; exact institution/member/country counts not stated by any source fetched this session.
